title: Ordinary component evaluation preserves pullback composition
statement: For arbitrary commutative coefficient rings R_n and transitions, f:X→Y, g:Y→Z and an ordinary semilinear system N on Z, the map ev_n(moduleGComp(f,g)_N) followed by moduleEvalG(f)_(g^*N) and f^*(moduleEvalG(g)_N) equals moduleEvalG(fg)_N followed by the constant-ring moduleGComp(f,g). This is the specified compositor normalization on ordinary systems; it uses no derived evaluation faithfulness.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 03DI and 09AE for open adjunctions, 0F7B for the intrinsic clopen construction. This normalization is an agent-formulated consequence.

proof.text: Take proper adjunction mates of moduleEvalG. Its unit normalization identifies the mate with moduleEvalP, identity on section carriers. Both pushforward compositors are restriction along the same canonical pullback-pasting map. Equality of these section maps and injectivity of mateEquiv give ordinaryModuleEvalG_comp.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryModuleEvalG_comp (n : ℕ) {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (N : Modules R φ Z) :
    (eval R φ X n).map ((moduleGComp R φ f g).hom.app N) ≫
        (moduleEvalG R φ f n).hom.app ((pull R φ g).obj N) ≫
        (StrictTower.modulePullback (R n) f).map ((moduleEvalG R φ g n).hom.app N) =
      (moduleEvalG R φ (f ≫ g) n).hom.app N ≫
        (StrictTower.moduleGComp (R n) f g).hom.app ((eval R φ Z n).obj N)
